title: LisseTowerAlgebraicDerivedPresentation
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, g:Y→X an immersion, d an adic coefficient datum on A, and M a normalized adic tower [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Let a≤b be integers. Assume every level has zero cohomology outside [a,b], and its restriction to Y has relatively finite-lisse cohomology over each constant quotient. There is a covering sieve V on the final pro-etale object of Y such that for every member U there is a pseudo-coherent E in D(AdicCompletion I A) [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex] with zero cohomology outside [a,b]. For every pair of scalar maps φ,β satisfying the evaluation/projection equations of [def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-realization-data], let c be their actual relative completed constant realization. Whenever c is additive and exact, the reductions of c_D(E) have relatively finite-lisse cohomology, and there are quotient-linear isomorphisms e_n from those reductions to the restricted M_n. For every m≥n, e_m followed by the restricted transition equals the canonical reduction transition of c_D(E) followed by restriction of e_n. This constructs an algebraic derived object and its derived finite reductions; it constructs no bounded termwise sheaf model.

proof.text: Apply the local algebraic reduction-diagram theorem using separate bounds (a,b) at every level. It gives a covering sieve and a normalized algebra tower K over the power quotients of C=AdicCompletion I A on every member, finite cohomology, a vanishing-transfer clause, and the geometric realization comparison for specified compatible algebraic reductions.

The completion is Noetherian and complete for J=IC. Prove the kernel formula for completion evaluation and use its surjectivity to obtain C/J^(n+1)≃A/I^(n+1), so these quotient rings are finite. Form the C-linear scalar restriction maps s from t via the canonical derived composition comparisons. Transfer the given interval vanishing to K.

Use countable products and complete one minus the transition shift to a distinguished triangle E→prod Res K_n→prod Res K_n→E[1]. Normalized algebraic effectivity proves E pseudo-coherent and identifies its actual projections with compatible derived reductions. Homology commutes with the products. Finite-ring finite-type homology is a finite set, so finite-group Mittag--Leffler makes the preceding homology Roos operator epi. The long exact sequence makes H^q(E) a subobject of the zero product for q outside [a,b], proving both endpoint bounds. No bounded finite term representative is chosen.

For each C→C/J^(n+1), choose the left adjoint supplied by derived module scalar adjunction. Apply the reconstruction result to these actual adjunctions and obtain its specified e_n and unit-compatibility equations. Feed E, these adjunctions, e_n and the equations to the finite-diagram realization comparison on the selected member of the covering sieve. Pair its conclusion with the pseudo-coherence and interval vanishing already proved.

theorem lisse_tower_algebraic_derived_presentation
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbounded : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))
    (hlisse : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) :
    ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ Y.ProEt), V ∈ ProEt.topology Y (⊤_ Y.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : Y.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ Y.ProEt), V f →
        ∃ E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)),
          DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent E ∧
          (∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
            IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj E)) ∧
          ∀ (φ : adicLisseConstantRing U.left (AdicCompletion d.ideal A) ⟶
      adicLisseCompletedRing U.left d.ideal)
            (_hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem U.left d.ideal) (op n) =
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology U.left) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.evalₐ d.ideal (n + 1)).toRingHom))
            (β : (adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).obj (adicLisseCompletedRing X d.ideal) ⟶
      adicLisseCompletedRing U.left d.ideal)
            (_hβ : ∀ n : ℕ, β ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem U.left d.ideal) (op n) =
      (adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map (limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem X d.ideal) (op n)) ≫
        proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap (U.hom ≫ g) CommRingCat.{u + 1}
          (CommRingCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))),
            let c := completedConstantRealization U.left d.ideal φ ⋙ pbcRestrict β ⋙
      pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map (pbcCompletedComparison X d).inv)
            ∀ (hc : c.Additive) (hlim : PreservesFiniteLimits c)
              (hcolim : PreservesFiniteColimits c),
              letI := hc
              letI := hlim
              letI := hcolim
              (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
                IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule (U.hom ≫ g) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
                  ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                    (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
                      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                        ((pbcDerivedExtend ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                  (pbcAdicProjection X d n))).obj (c.mapDerivedCategory.obj E))))) ∧
              ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, (pbcDerivedExtend ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                  (pbcAdicProjection X d n))).obj (c.mapDerivedCategory.obj E) ≅
                  (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj
                    (M.level n),
                ∀ (m n : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m),
                  (e m).hom ≫ adicTowerRestrictedTransition d (U.hom ≫ g) M m n hnm =
                    pbcReductionTransition
                ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map (pbcAdicProjection X d m))
                ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n hnm))
                ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map (pbcAdicProjection X d n))
                (((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map_comp _ _).symm.trans
                  (congrArg (adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                    (pbcAdicProjection_comp X d m n hnm)))
                (c.mapDerivedCategory.obj E) ≫
                      (pbcDerivedRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                        (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n hnm))).map (e n).hom
